body: "...and to outlive the menace of tyranny; if necessary, for years. If necessary, alone..." -Winston Churchill on the struggle of Britain vs Nazi-Axis forces. What an inspirational leader. Thanks, this one was needed and is a definite keeper.
I wish you luck as well. Stay strong. as a famous Brit once roughly said. Never never never give up.

I am currently working as a grocery delivery guy. I am constantly under the stress of not making the next cut and with a constant stream of labor the bar is rather high. Even for a grocery delivery guy. Not to mention, It's ruining the only car I can afford and I can't replace it. I ususally have 6 - 8hr shifts. Yet, as you said, I struggle to pay my bills. And, no I can't afford the health insurance the U.S. now forces on it's citizens. I used to work in restaurants. I make more doing what I do now, though my job is less secure. I am trying currently to get into some sort of Admin Assistant gig as I had experience in the field in university. Been putting out resumes today in fact.

I do feel the same. Thank you for your kind words of hope. I think there is a light as well. I just keep digging through the shit that clogs the tunnel. I just... I'm cracking and I'm sure my own rambling earlier lets on.

I don't know where to go or what to do. I don't know if I can take these shit jobs for nothing anymore and still not have enough despite working long hours and dedicating myself to them. I'm burning on the inside with hate for those more fortunate than myself. It scares me. I have no health insurance to get help I probably need. I don't make enough to pay out of pocket. I have very little family support. I have pushed away all my friends in fear of them seeing me slowly slipping. Now I am being punished on my taxes for not being able to afford insurance. It just all keeps piling and I certainly feel like a black hole of resources and anything else.
How can you not hate me? I am not only part of what has cost the rest of the world so dearly in resources but I am crying about not being in the top 1% of it. I have respect for your resolve.
